notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1936. Curated: Works Progress Administration projects (Kezar Stadium and its press stand, the Lincoln Park golf clubhouse, the Zoo extension and Lion House), the police stables' completion, the Palace of Fine Arts and the arboretum.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: WPA convenience stations in Golden Gate Park (Panhandle, horseshoe courts, near 14th Avenue and the Main Drive, near 19th Avenue and the South Drive), the Aquatic Park WPA plans, Lucien Labaudt's Beach Chalet sketches (already covered from the Art Commission), the final payment to Arthur Brown, Jr. for the Coit Tower, small mammal houses at the Zoo.
coverage.note: Twelve meetings held, Jan 16 to Dec 9. The IA items labelled 1934 and 1935 repeat the 1933 and 1936 volumes, so 1934-35 are missing. Dated by the opener 'was held ... on <weekday>, <date>'. Curated list PB1936.py.

findings.address_as_written: Resolution No. 139 - architects, Kezar Stadium rehabilitation
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners appointed Masten & Hurd architects for the rehabilitation of Kezar Stadium under the Works Progress Administration, at six per cent of an estimated contract price of $35,000.

findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners approved Lewis P. Hobart's general plans for extending the Zoo, to be built unit by unit as the Works Progress Administration found the money, in the order monkey island, flight cages, bear pit, lion and tiger house and bird cages, with Hobart paid six per cent of each unit for its detailed plans.
